- Added the `retired` workspace stop kind (migration `044_workspace_stop_kind_retired.sql`): a workspace the gen-2 migration cannot take, archived for its owner and stopped for good. `POST /admin/workspaces/{id}/stop` accepts `{"kind": "retired"}`; the owner's start answers `409 {"code": "workspace_retired", ...}` with a message pointing at the workspace's backups, and the operator start refuses a retired row the same way (`set-stop-kind idle` is the deliberate way back).

- Stop/start transfers are fenced on the box as well as in the row: a launch records the transition token in the transfer dir, kills a transfer a fenced-out supervisor left running there, and clears every file an earlier run wrote before backgrounding; the liveness probe answers only for the token that launched the running script; and every upload/download pipeline removes its hash/size tap files before it starts, so a manifest can no longer record another run's hashes or a key another run did not encrypt to (the failure that broke two production artifacts before the fencing rework).
